name: Entity Reference Field Widgets
description: A suite of entity-reference field UX widgets: a hierarchical taxonomy autocomplete widget/selection plugin, and an Inline Entity Form (complex) enhancement adding an autocomplete-driven create-new option.
project_description:
Additional widgets for use on Entity Reference fields.

 Currently supported:

 
 Hierarchical Term Select 
 
 Allows selections to be dependent on a parent selection. 
 
 IEF Autocomplete Create 
 
 Allows autocomplete to have a "Add new" option using IEF. 
 
 
 INSTALLATION 
 ------------

Install the module per normal

 Hierarchical Select : 
 1. Add a new vocabulary, and terms with hierarchy

2. Set the form widget on Taxonomy Term Reference to use the Hierarchical Select

 IEF Autocomplete Create (Requires IEF) 
 1. Set the form widget to Inline Entity Form - Complex

2. Check the box: "Enable Autocomplete Create Option"

3. Configure helper/new item text
